reason: Almost all my collabs are cafés giving me a free meal for a reel, so there's no rate to negotiate and no payment to chase. I might try the free media kit, but I wouldn't pay for Pro or give up 5% when I'm barely getting cash deals yet.
objection: Local cafés pay in food, not money. A fair-rate counter-offer won't change that, and if I push back with a price they'll just pick another creator. I'm already on Influish applying and waiting, so this is one more app.
would_change_my_mind: If Mitra actually brought me paid collabs, or showed proof that creators my size in South Bengaluru turned barter offers into cash using it.
